$comment: Single source of the tested browser stack. CI installs camoufox.tag and the browser-stack gate checks playwright-core against it. camoufox.linuxX64Sha256 is the SHA-256 of that release's lin.x86_64.zip asset (its GitHub digest without the sha256: prefix); the installer refuses any other bytes, so move it with the tag. camoufox.protocolSha256 and playwrightCore.protocolSha256 (keyed by exact x.y.z version) are the SHA-256 of each side's Juggler Protocol.js as the gate fetches it; the gate refuses other bytes, so move the Camoufox pin with the tag and add the version pin with the playwright-core bump. The values are the tested pair: change only the component being upgraded, and raise testedMinor only after its gate and contract tests pass; scripts/browser-stack/manifest.mjs validates this file.
